features: Accurate GPS Tracking with 5-Point Positioning: Stay connected with your child's where abouts using real-time GPS tracking backed by a reliable 5-point positioning system. View the current location, last recorded location, battery level, and tracking time stamp directly from the boAt Sailor App.

Geo-Fencing with Safe Zone Alerts: Create virtual Safe Zones with geo-fencing features for places like school, tuition classes, or your residential society and receive notifications whenever your child enters or leaves them.

4G Enabled Two-Way Video & Voice Calling: See and talk to your child anytime with high-definition face-to-face video and voice calls powered by 4G connectivity. For added peace of mind, parents can whitelist trusted contacts through the boAt Sailor App, ensuring your child only connects with pre-approved friends and family.

Emergency SOS with Power Button: The dedicated SOS feature allows your child to call the saved emergency contacts by simply pressing and holding the power button for 3 seconds. Designed for emergencies, it ensures help is just one press away.

1.44" (3.65 cm) Bright HD Display: Engineered for tiny hands, the bright 1.44” HD touch screen offers smooth, ultra-responsive navigation. Your child can easily swipe through the watch menus, make calls, and access watch features.

2MP Magic Camera with Remote Photo Capture: Capture clear real-time photos of your child’s face using the built-in 2MP magic camera. Parents can also remotely trigger the camera through the Sailor Nav app, with captured images automatically uploaded for viewing.

Advanced Parental Controls: Take complete control of your child's smartwatch experience with features like Class Mode, Stranger Call Protection, Video Chat Disable, Shutdown Restriction, Dial Pad Disable, and Location History. Parents can also schedule distraction-free school hours while ensuring only trusted contacts can communicate with your child.

Daily Step Counter: Encourage healthy habits early on with the built-in daily step counter that tracks your child's activity throughout the day. It motivates your child to stay active while helping parents monitor their daily progress in a simple and engaging way.

Schedule Alarms, Calculator & Stopwatch: Help your child build early morning routines and manage their time better. Schedule morning or study alarms remotely via the app, while handy on-wrist tools like the calculator and stopwatch support their daily learning and playful activities.
Built-in Offline Games: The smartwatch features curated, kid-friendly built-in games that provide offline entertainment without exposure to the open internet or unsafe social media platforms.
